name: AINumbers MCP Apps
description: Where agents run the same workflows people do. This server is step 2 (Run) of the AINumbers estate pipeline: Learn -> Run -> Verify -> Anchor -> Keep. Agents call this server to execute OpenChainGraph compute tools and get back hash-anchored, verifiable artifacts. Receipts from runs here land in the Ledger (step 3, ledger.ainumbers.co) for verification. Artifacts can then be anchored as independent evidence at the Anchor suite (step 4, anchor.ainumbers.co).

after.note: Receipts from this server verify at the Ledger

anchor.note: Artifacts can be independently timestamped and signed at the Anchor suite
